title: AI & Automation Engineer
description: Looking to take your digital career to a whole new level? Then this role is for you!First Page is a certified “GREAT PLACE TO WORK” and is a global digital marketing firm that transforms the way companies do business online. Since 2011 our mission has been to create amazing digital experiences by implementing game-changing digital strategies. As APAC’s highest-rated digital agency, First Page has seen insane growth and won numerous awards over the past 3 years.1. The RoleAs an AI & Automation Engineer, you’ll build, deploy, and maintain production-grade AI features and workflow automations across the business.This is a hands-on engineering role. Working closely with our AI Lead, you will turn business requirements into reliable working code—building API pipelines, integrating LLMs and third-party SaaS tools, and ensuring our internal systems run smoothly.You will also play an active part in AI adoption by documenting your work clearly and helping team members use the tools and workflows you build effectively.2. What You’ll DoBuild AI Features & Workflow AutomationsDesign, build, and maintain Python-based AI workflows and integrations.Connect external platforms (CRMs, databases, marketing tools) via robust REST APIs with proper authentication and error handling.Implement LLM-based features using providers like OpenAI, DeepSeek, or OpenRouter, keeping track of output quality, latency, and costs.Build resilient, idempotent workflows with appropriate logging, retries, and rate-limiting.Write clean, testable code and help debug production issues when they arise.Maintain Code Quality & ReliabilityParticipate in code reviews and collaborate with the AI Lead on technical implementation details.Add automated tests and basic CI checks to ensure system stability before shipping.Maintain clear operational documentation, playbooks, and reusable templates.Continuously refine existing internal scripts and automations based on real-world feedback.Enable Team AdoptionDemonstrate new AI tools and automated workflows to internal non-technical teams.Explain practical AI concepts and workflows in clear, straightforward language.Gather user feedback to iterate on tools and improve operational adoption.3. Who We’re Looking ForYou are a pragmatic, hands-on developer who loves taking repetitive manual tasks or complex business problems and turning them into reliable automated systems.You understand that practical AI engineering is not just about prompt tuning—it requires clean Python code, dependable data handling, thoughtful cost management, and practical software engineering principles. You are curious, eager to learn, and enjoy shipping tools that make immediate operational impact.4. RequirementsMust Have2–4 years of hands-on software or automation engineering experience.Solid, production-ready Python skills.Practical experience building features using LLM APIs (OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, or similar) beyond basic prototypes.Familiarity with LLM evaluation, prompt structuring, and managing cost/latency trade-offs.Strong experience with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, and integrating third-party SaaS tools (experience with HubSpot or similar CRMs is a big plus).Experience with background scheduling, error handling, retries, and building resilient data pipelines.Proficient with Git/GitHub workflows (branches, PRs, basic GitHub Actions or CI/CD pipelines).Good problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases and debug production issues.Clear written and verbal communication skills in English.Nice to HaveExperience building simple internal dashboards or front-end tools (React or similar).Basic experience with cloud hosting, Docker containers, or serverless functions.Exposure to task queues, event-driven workflows, or background workers.Exposure to digital marketing, agency operations, SEO, or lead generation funnels.5. Why First Page?Real Production Impact: The systems you build directly support our day-to-day business operations and client delivery.Fast-Paced Learning: Work alongside our AI Lead and gain direct experience with cutting-edge LLMs, frameworks, and deployment practices.Tooling Autonomy: Freedom to use the best models and tech stack for the problem at hand.Direct Ownership: High visibility in a nimble engineering setup where your code goes to production quickly. title: AI Engineer
description: The Role You will take our AI stack and lead its development and customisation for the UK & IE market.This is a builder and do-er role. You will design, test and implement practical and compliant AI solutions across the business. This could include document understanding, classification and decision support, retrieval over our own knowledge and procedures, intelligent automation, and agents capable of carrying out multi-step business processes end to end.You are not being asked to train models from scratch. You are being asked to make models that already exist behave reliably enough for people to trust them in real business processes, particularly where accuracy, compliance and good decision-making matter.Working closely with Operations, Commercial, Compliance, Finance, Transformation, IT and Group teams, you will turn business needs into scalable solutions.Key Responsibilities Develop and customise AI solutions for the UK & IE market, from prototype through to production ownership.Be curious and prepared to self-learn to use generative-AI to build agents that make a difference to our business.Identify AI, automation and decision-support opportunities across the business, including Operations, Commercial, Compliance and Finance, and size them honestly before building.Design solutions using generative AI and large language models — retrieval, tool calling, structured extraction from business and customs documentation, and agentic workflows where they genuinely fit.Own the evaluation. Define how we know a solution is working before it ships, and how we know a change has not made it worse. This is treated as core to the role, not an afterthought.Manage pilots and implementation, and set the criteria for killing a pilot as clearly as the criteria for scaling it.Monitor performance, inference cost, latency and business impact.Collaborate with local teams, Group functions and technology partners.Contribute to privacy, security and AI governance compliance, working with Group Legal and IT Security. You should understand how the EU AI Act applies to what you build, and be able to produce the documentation that goes with it.Requirements Essential Demonstrable experience integrating large language models into production systems — prompt and context design, retrieval-augmented generation, structured output, and handling failure gracefully.Practical experience with at least one major cloud AI platform (Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex).Solid software/backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, testing and CI/CD. Most of this job is engineering.Strong communication skills — you will spend real time with subject-matter experts across the business who understand their processes deeply but may not have a technical or AI background.Full production code ownership. Not familiarity.You do not need to arrive with customs experience, but you should be curious and able to learn complex business processes quickly.Professional fluency in English.Desirable Evaluation engineering: building eval harnesses and regression suites for non-deterministic systems, LLM-as-judge approaches, and human-in-the-loop review design. This is the single strongest signal we look for and we will weight it heavily.Context engineering: designing and version-controlling what a model sees — retrieval strategy, memory, tool descriptions, and policy layers that constrain what an agent is allowed to do.Agent orchestration frameworks and standards (LangGraph, MCP, Temporal or equivalent), and experience with long-running or multi-step agent workflows.Observability and cost control for inference at volume.What Success Looks Like in Your First Year By month three: You understand our business and priority processes well enough to identify where AI can genuinely add value, challenge what we ask for, and you have shipped one small, useful thing.By month six: At least one AI solution is live, measured against a baseline, and demonstrably better than what it replaced.By month twelve: There is a working evaluation process others can use, a ranked pipeline of next opportunities, and at least two colleagues outside IT operating what you have built without you in the room. title: AI Technical Product Manager (QVAC) (100% remote)
description: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices, it gives users greater control over their data and how they use artificial intelligence. Our focus is on local, on-device, and privacy-preserving AI, with opportunities to connect these experiences across Tether’s peer-to-peer ecosystem. We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong interest in AI and a practical understanding of how to turn emerging capabilities into useful products. You will work closely with the Product Lead to help advance the QV.AC vision: identifying valuable use cases, defining AI features, exploring product concepts, and working with engineering and design to bring them to users. You’ll contribute to product direction and take responsibility for moving assigned features from discovery through delivery and iteration. This role suits someone who knows how to leverage AI to the maximum and enjoys experimenting with new AI technologies, understands its possibilities and limitations, and cares about making complex technology easy to use. Responsibilities Help shape AI features: Work with the Product Lead to translate the QV.AC vision into concrete use cases, feature proposals, and product requirements. Bring ideas grounded in user needs, research, and hands-on experimentation. Understand users and their problems: Gather feedback, conduct research, and explore how people use AI in their everyday workflows. Identify where AI can solve a meaningful problem and where a simpler solution may work better. Turn ideas into clear specifications: Write product briefs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and user flows that help engineering and design understand the intended experience, constraints, and measures of success. Prototype and explore: Create wireframes, mockups, and working prototypes to test ideas and communicate product behavior. Use AI-assisted tools to explore concepts quickly and refine them with the team. Collaborate on technical trade-offs: Work with engineers to understand what is feasible across devices and models. Help assess the impact of response quality, latency, memory usage, battery consumption, and privacy on the user experience. Support prioritization and planning: Help the Product Lead evaluate opportunities, clarify scope, identify dependencies, and maintain a focused backlog aligned with product priorities. Drive feature delivery: Follow assigned features through development, resolve product questions, review the experience, and coordinate feedback and release readiness with relevant teams. Stay close to AI developments: Explore new AI products, models, tools, and interaction patterns, and explain their practical relevance to QV.AC . Share clear recommendations about what is worth testing or adopting and why. Mandatory: 7+ years of product management experience, ideally working on AI software products with technical engineering teams. Practical experience building, shipping, or prototyping AI-powered features, with the ability to explain your contribution and what you learned. A working understanding of AI concepts such as inference, harnesses, model capabilities and limitations, context, and evaluation, alongside an interest in local and on-device AI. The ability to translate an ambiguous idea into a clear user problem, proposed solution, and actionable requirements. Strong product judgment, with attention to usability, scope, and measurable user value. Confidence creating prototypes using design or coding tools Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to discuss technical trade-offs with engineers and explain them to non-technical colleagues. A proactive, collaborative approach: comfortable taking responsibility for your work, asking questions early, and incorporating feedback. Familiarity with product analytics, user research, and iterative software development. Preferred: Experience with local AI, on-device inference, or open-source models. Experience building AI assistants, conversational interfaces, or multimodal features. Familiarity with desktop or mobile product development. An understanding of peer-to-peer technologies and decentralized applications. Experience evaluating AI output quality and designing user experiences that account for uncertainty and errors. Experience working in a distributed team. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common.
